rules.applies_when: hardware/software endpoint mapping is created or changed
actions: trace each endpoint to source and test
acceptance: every required hardware endpoint has exactly one compatible software owner
direction voltage and reset default agree on both sides
rules.failure_policy: mark CONFLICT and block affected integration

rules.applies_when: events span hardware and software timing
acceptance: each software action waits on a verified condition or derived bound
all safety deadlines are met by measured/verified result
no arbitrary delay is sole synchronization
rules.failure_policy: timing stays UNKNOWN and blocks safety/reliability claim

rules.applies_when: multiple contributors determine a system limit
actions: sum or combine using declared worst-case/statistical method
acceptance: all contributors use compatible units and stated conditions
calculated total plus required margin satisfies requirement
any missing required contributor yields UNKNOWN
rules.failure_policy: do not convert incomplete budget to PASS

rules.applies_when: hardware events and software actions form a state machine
actions: trace outputs during reset disconnect and partial failure
acceptance: every state/event pair has explicit behavior or rejection
no fault path leaves actuator/output undefined
recovery does not require cloud/network for local safety
rules.failure_policy: block integration on undefined safety transition

rules.applies_when: independently versioned components must work together
acceptance: unknown or absent tuple is BLOCKED
rules.failure_policy: reject mixed version and identify compatible recovery tuple

rules.applies_when: one professional domain changes a shared contract
acceptance: every changed field has producer/consumer updates or compatible behavior
all mandatory affected tests have evidence
field and production impact is recorded
rules.failure_policy: hold merge/release while any mandatory consumer is unverified
